title: FAIRNESS IS NOT ENOUGH: Auditing Competence and Intersectional Bias in AI-powered Résumé Screening

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in fictitious résumés, comparing AI-generated numeric candidate ratings (1-100) for names statistically associated with Black, Hispanic, and White groups against a baseline redacted résumé.

Counterfactual name substitution in fictitious résumés, comparing AI-generated numeric candidate ratings (1-100) for traditionally male-coded and female-coded names against a baseline redacted résumé.

Analyzing the interaction effects of race and gender by measuring scoring deviations for six distinct race-gender intersectional groups (e.g., White male, Black female) using specific name variations.
